# Draft:Nomadic Warriors for Pritzker

----
Nomadic Warriors for Pritzker is a community created to support JB Pritzker, the Governor of Illinois.
The original Twitter (now X) account was created by Trip Venturella in 2022. He created the account to support Pritzker, as other political ideologies, like Socialists for Pritzker or Frat Bros for Pritzker already existed.
Pritzker mentioned the nomadic warriors in his 2022 victory speech after winning a second term as governor, saying “facing this moment requires that every happy warrior find a little bit of a nomadic warrior in them as well.”
In the 2024 presidential election, the account, and other “Pritzker Pals” accounts like Socialists for Pritzker, registered a site to influence Kamala Harris to pick Pritzker as her running mate after Joe Biden dropped out. While they were able to influence the election, Tim Walz was chosen as Kamala's running mate.
